title: CL2GEC: A Multi-Discipline Benchmark for Continual Learning in Chinese Literature Grammatical Error Correction
reasoning: The paper focuses on grammatical error correction in academic literature across multiple disciplines. While some sentences in the dataset (e.g., within the Economics and Philosophy categories) discuss ethics or morality, the research objective is to benchmark linguistic correction capabilities, not to evaluate or benchmark models on their understanding or adherence to religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
